positive_cases.name: read_access_from_temp_binary
positive_cases.scenario: Unmanaged binary in a temporary directory requests memory read access.
positive_cases.rationale: Target, access mask, and absence of the agent filter all hold.

positive_cases.name: extended_access_from_script_host
positive_cases.scenario: Script host requests an extended access mask against the authentication process.
positive_cases.rationale: Target, access mask, and absence of the agent filter all hold.

negative_cases.name: query_limited_information
negative_cases.scenario: Monitoring tool opens the authentication process for limited query rights.
negative_cases.rationale: Target matches but the access mask is not in the selection.

negative_cases.name: known_security_agent
negative_cases.scenario: Endpoint security agent inspects the authentication process.
negative_cases.rationale: Target and mask match but the source image filter removes the event.

negative_cases.name: access_to_service_host
negative_cases.scenario: Diagnostic tool opens a service host process with a read mask.
negative_cases.rationale: Access mask matches but the target process is not the authentication process.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
